title: SURF-101 misses a command synopsis written as pipe-separated alternatives
foundBy: user report: "SURF-101 misses a command synopsis written as pipe-separated alternatives"
details:
A document that states its command surface as pipe-separated alternatives gets no SURF-101 finding, however stale the verbs are.

```sh
tool doctor|pin|manual|version
```

`strings.Fields` reads `doctor|pin|manual|version` as one word. That word does not match `verbWord`, so the walk stops before a single alternative reaches the binary. A `pin` the tool no longer carries sits there unreported.

The rule works on the ordinary form. A fenced `tool frobnicate` on a documented page is reported:

```
SURF-101 error     `tool frobnicate` is documented and the binary does not have it
```

So the gap is the shape rather than the check. Splitting the word on `|` before resolving each alternative would close it, provided a genuine pipeline is still read as one.

The synopsis form is conventional in a spec section or a man page. That is where a project states its surface most compactly, and where drift is least visible.
